actual Grand Total is 102.00 — leading '1' misread as '7' by Tesseract"},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","issue":"Returned 23.26 (Total Inclusive of GST line) instead of final printed TOTAL 23.25 after rounding adjustment"},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","issue":"Returned null (empty); OCR missed the Grand Total number on same line and 'Change' line was correctly excluded, so no value extracted"}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","summary":"OCR digit confusion (1↔7, 0↔O, etc.) not mitigated by multi-pass consensus or sanity checks against subtotal/item sums"},{"id":"rc2","summary":"When multiple TOTAL-family lines exist with the SAME priority tier (e.g., 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' and final 'TOTAL:' after rounding), the skill does not prefer the LAST occurrence, which is typically the final payable amount after rounding adjustment"},{"id":"rc3","summary":"Two-line fallback logic is too narrow: when the keyword line has no number and the immediately next non-empty line is an exclusion keyword (e.g., 'Change'), extraction aborts instead of scanning further down for the amount or looking at the preceding/adjacent column"},{"id":"rc4","summary":"Date extraction does not disambiguate DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY using contextual hints (e.g., day>12) or cross-check against other date tokens on the receipt"},{"id":"rc5","summary":"No fallback OCR variant voting across preprocessing modes (upscale, invert, threshold) that could outvote a single-pass digit misread like '102'→'702'"}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"The current draft's extract_total algorithm takes the FIRST matching line within a tier scanning top-to-bottom; for receipts where multiple same-tier TOTAL lines appear (pre-rounding and post-rounding), the final printed total is almost always the LAST one. Documentation even notes this ambiguity but code picks first."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Two-line fallback only looks at the single next non-empty line and bails out on exclusion; it should scan a small window (next 1–3 lines) and also inspect the SAME line for right-column numeric values when keyword and amount are separated by whitespace runs that Tesseract may split into two lines."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR variants are described but results are concatenated rather than used for per-field majority voting across variants, so a single-pass digit error propagates."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction patterns do not include a disambiguation step (e.g., if first number >12, it must be the day → DMY) and don't cross-verify against other date-like tokens on the same receipt."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No sanity check comparing extracted total against item-line sums or subtotal keyword values when both are OCR-visible, which could catch gross digit misreads like 102→702."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"In the total-extraction rules, change tier selection to: 'within a matched tier, prefer the LAST matching non-excluded line (bottom-most occurrence) because final printed totals after rounding adjustments appear below pre-rounding totals'. Keep tier priority order unchanged."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand two-line fallback: when the keyword line has no numeric match, scan up to the next 3 non-empty lines; skip exclusion lines but do not abort — continue to subsequent lines until a numeric or a new tier-boundary keyword is encountered."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a multi-variant voting helper: run OCR with ≥3 preprocessing variants (grayscale+autocontrast, 2× upscale, binarized threshold) and ≥2 PSM modes; for each variant extract a candidate total using the same rules; return the modal (majority) value, breaking ties by (a) higher-priority tier, (b) value closer to a detected SUBTOTAL+tax approximation if available."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'plausibility check' step: if extracted total has leading digits that could be OCR confusions (7↔1, 8↔3, 0↔O, 5↔S), and a SUBTOTAL/items-sum is available on the receipt with a value differing by exactly a leading-digit substitution, prefer the subtotal-consistent candidate."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen date rules: (1) add explicit DMY-vs-MDY disambiguation — if either the first or second number is >12, assign unambiguously; (2) when both ≤12, default to DMY for receipts (document that this is a regional heuristic typical for Malaysian/SG/MY receipts in the sample domain); (3) collect all date-like tokens and prefer the one appearing near keywords 'Date', 'INV', 'Receipt', 'Invoice'."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document and codify the rounding-adjustment pattern explicitly: 'If the receipt shows both a pre-rounding total and a final TOTAL/Net Total line separated by a Rounding Adj line, always return the final (post-rounding) line's value.'"},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Normalize numeric strings before validation: strip currency prefixes (RM, $), strip stray letters attached to digits (e.g., '86.17C' → '86.17'), and reject candidates whose decimal portion is missing (e.g., bare integers) when the receipt otherwise contains two-decimal amounts in the same tier."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a self-check that logs (not blocks) when the chosen total equals a line also matching exclusion keywords on an adjacent line (e.g., CASH TENDERED or CHANGE), prompting a re-scan for a tighter match within the TOTAL tier."}],"confidence":0.72}
